# Plan — run 01 (orchestrator)

Deadline 2026-11-02T20:17:09Z; stop new work 20:14:09Z. Frozen app verified before work: eee783057ec28d28fb36ec05484de9b4b40ceb9c (41 files).

- A1 (rule-analyst, now): rules/ + EARS specs/ for task-approval slice (permission + starting-state guard), fixtures and assertions for success / role refusal / wrong-state refusal. Budget 3m.
- T1 (test-engineer, now, parallel): validate prepared runtime (start/reset/sql/fixture/test/coverage), login + task-action request mechanics, seeded users/tasks, test skeleton. Budget 3m.
- T2 (test-engineer, after A1 accepted): implement real-HTTP tests naming EARS/rule IDs + machine-readable mapping; run suite + coverage. Budget 3m.
- INT (orchestrator): integrate accepted branches into ~/outputs, single integration commit.
- V1 (verifier, after INT pushed): independent fresh-database run of integrated tests at named commit, integrity checks, coverage scope check. Budget 3m.
- Closeout: reports/run-summary.json, reports/attempts.json, findings/ledger.json, final frozen-app check, commit, reply.
